How do I contact your support team if I have an issue with an order?
I can help with order issues right here, so there is no need to track down a phone number or email. Tell me what has gone wrong (and your order number if you have it) and I will guide you through the next steps.
Here is how we usually resolve the most common problems:
Change or cancel an order: Orders move quickly, so we will try to help but it is not guaranteed. Once an order is processed, it cannot be cancelled or changed. If it has already been processed, you can send it back once it arrives. If you cancel your whole order within 14 days of receiving your goods, we will refund the cost of standard shipping for that order. If you paid for a faster delivery service, we refund only the standard delivery cost.
Order not arrived: First check your tracking for the latest updates. If it still looks stuck or unusual, let me know what the tracking shows and I will advise the next steps.
Add an offer or gift card after ordering: It may be possible depending on the order status. Share the code and I will check what can be done.
If you tell me what you need help with, I will sort it from here.

Do you price match or honor a price drop after purchase?
Great question. We do not have a price‑match or post‑purchase price‑adjustment option to share here. Prices and promotions can change over time, and sale items are excluded from any further offers. You can check current offer exclusions on our exclusions page.
If you see a lower price after you have ordered and would like to take advantage of it, the simplest option is to place a new order at the lower price and return the original order within our returns window, provided it is eligible for return. Once the original is received back and processed, the refund will go back to your original payment method. If you would like me to check whether a specific item is included in a current offer, tell me the product name or link and I will confirm.
